crossRefs.note: When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his…
For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that…
They who render evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
The way of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.
Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.
Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.
being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has…
Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t…

translations.web: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?
translations.bsb: Who can harm you if you are zealous for what is good?
translations.kjv: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
translations.asv: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be zealous of that which is good?
